elements.name: Anchor

elements.name: Animate
elements.desc: Declarative animation — tween an attribute over time.
elements.base:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <rect width="40" height="40" fill="#4d8bff"><animate attributeName="x" from="10" to="60" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"></animate></rect>
</svg>

elements.name: Animate motion
elements.desc: Animate an element along a motion path.
elements.base:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <rect width="40" height="40" fill="#4d8bff"><animateMotion dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M0 0 L60 60"></animateMotion></rect>
</svg>

elements.name: Animate transform
elements.desc: Animate a transform (translate, scale, rotate…).

elements.name: Pattern
elements.desc: A tiled motif that repeats across any fill.
elements.base: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><defs><pattern id="slot" width="20" height="20" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="6" fill="#f5a623"/></pattern></defs><rect x="5" y="5" width="90" height="90" fill="url(#slot)"/></svg>

elements.name: Polygon
elements.desc: A closed shape built from a list of points.
elements.base: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><polygon points="50,10 90,80 10,80" fill="#16c79a" stroke="#16c79a" stroke-width="2"></polygon></svg>

elements.name: Polyline
elements.desc: A connected run of straight segments through a list of points.
elements.base: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><polyline points="10,80 40,20 70,60 90,10" fill="none" stroke="#e94560" stroke-width="3"></polyline></svg>

elements.name: Radial gradient
elements.desc: A colour blend radiating from a focal point.
elements.base: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><defs><radialGradient id="slot"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#e94560"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#16c79a"/></radialGradient></defs><rect x="5" y="5" width="90" height="90" fill="url(#slot)"/></svg>

elements.name: Rectangle
elements.desc: The fundamental box primitive — position, size and corner radius.
elements.base: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><rect x="10" y="10" width="80" height="80" fill="#e94560" stroke="#16c79a" stroke-width="2"></rect></svg>

elements.name: Set
elements.desc: Set an attribute to a value for a span of time.
elements.base: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><rect id="target" x="10" y="41" width="18" height="18" fill="#4d8bff"><set attributeName="x" from="10" to="60" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"></set></rect></svg>

elements.name: Stop
elements.desc: One colour stop within a gradient.
elements.base: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100" color="#f5a623"><defs><linearGradient id="slot"><stop offset="0.3" stop-color="#e94560"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#f5a623"></stop><stop offset="1" stop-color="#4d8bff"/></linearGradient></defs><rect x="5" y="5" width="90" height="90" fill="url(#slot)"/></svg>

elements.name: SVG root
elements.desc: The root canvas (or a nested viewport).
elements.base: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100" color="#16c79a"><svg><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" fill="currentColor"/></svg></svg>

elements.name: Switch
elements.desc: The <switch> SVG element.
elements.base: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100" color="#16c79a"><switch><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" fill="currentColor"/></switch></svg>

elements.name: Symbol
elements.desc: The <symbol> SVG element.
elements.base: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100" color="#16c79a"><defs><symbol id="slot"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="60" fill="currentColor"/></symbol></defs><use href="#slot" x="10" y="10" width="80" height="80"/></svg>

elements.name: Text
elements.desc: Real, selectable type rendered as vectors.
elements.base: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100" color="#16c79a"><text x="10" y="55" fill="currentColor" font-size="20">Ag</text></svg>

elements.name: Text path
elements.desc: Text laid out along an arbitrary path.
elements.base: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100" color="#16c79a"><defs><path id="slot" d="M 5 70 Q 50 10 95 70"/></defs><text font-size="20"><textPath href="#slot" fill="currentColor" font-size="20">Ag</textPath></text></svg>

elements.name: Text span
elements.desc: A styled run inside a text element.
elements.base: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100" color="#16c79a"><text x="10" y="55" font-size="18"><tspan x="10" y="55" fill="currentColor" font-size="20">Ag</tspan></text></svg>

elements.name: Use
elements.desc: Reuse a defined element by reference.
elements.base: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100" color="#16c79a"><defs><circle id="slot" cx="50" cy="50" r="32" fill="currentColor"/></defs><use href="#slot" x="10" y="10"></use></svg>

elements.name: View
elements.desc: The <view> SVG element.
elements.base:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <defs><view></view></defs>
  <circle cx="20" cy="20" r="15" fill="#e94560"/>
  <rect x="55" y="10" width="30" height="30" fill="#16c79a" rx="4"/>
  <polygon points="50,60 35,90 65,90" fill="#f5a623"/>
</svg>
